remarks: This is a spacious and light filled first floor apartment in two unit home, it feels like a single family home as it is surrounded by a large yard and adorned by a lovely porch. A very spacious and sunny Living room with two picture windows and lots of light. It has a beautifully newly refinished hardwood floor from the entry through the living areas. The dining area adjacent to kitchen with SS appliances.  There are 3 bedrooms with two full baths. Washer/dryer in the apartment. There is a garage for one car and parking in the driveway for another and more for guests, It is a 7 minute walk or less to downtown New Canaan and the train to NY. Great school system.
